project.name: Swiftdrop
project.description: A courier app for local shops, drivers, and dispatchers with delivery status flow and photo proof.

direction.palette: Appetizing warm (orange/red) + trust blue + map accent

app.name: Swiftdrop
app.tagline: Fast local shop parcel deliveries and courier dispatch

help.doorPhoto: Photo taken of parcel placed at the door upon delivery
help.fee: Payment fee earned by the courier for fulfilling this delivery
help.parcelSize: Size category of the parcel (small, medium, large)

help.isOnline: Indicates whether the driver is actively available to accept delivery offers

looks.reason: Clean modern mobile interface with translucent panels keeping active maps and steps visible.
Fast, distraction-free flat UI prioritizing rapid order scanning and street readability.

tours.name: Parcel Delivery Fulfillment
tours.outcome: Parcel is picked up from the shop, delivered to the customer door with photo proof, and earnings are credited.

steps.title: Books a delivery with pickup, drop-off, customer contact, and parcel size (the delivery becomes pending). Rule: Must provide valid pickup address, drop-off address, customer name, phone, and parcel size
Switches status to online to receive offers (the driver_shift becomes online). Rule: Driver must be authenticated
Accepts an available delivery offer (the delivery becomes assigned). Rule: Only one driver can take each offer and a driver carries one delivery at a time
Confirms heading toward pickup location (the delivery becomes going_to_pickup). Rule: Must be the assigned driver
Confirms parcel collected from shop (the delivery becomes picked_up). Rule: Must be at pickup location
Confirms heading toward drop-off location (the delivery becomes going_to_dropoff). Rule: Must have picked up the parcel
Submits photo of parcel at door and confirms completion (the delivery becomes delivered). Rule: A photo of the parcel at the door is required
Views delivery tracking page with live status updates. Rule: Must have a valid delivery tracking identifier

tours.name: Driver Earnings Review
tours.outcome: Driver reviews their accumulated delivery earnings for today and the current week.

steps.title: Views total delivery earnings for today and this week. Rule: Aggregates fees only from successfully delivered parcels

tours.name: Dispatch Operations Monitoring
tours.outcome: Dispatcher verifies delivery statuses and fleet availability to keep local fulfillment running smoothly.

steps.title: Reviews all deliveries filtered by status and monitors which drivers are online. Rule: Displays real-time status of all active deliveries and online drivers
